ability.name: Teravolt
ability.note: This Pokémon can only be set as a form in the deck. The effects of Abilities of the battle opponent that increase or decrease Attack damage are nullified. This Pokémon can MP move over other Pokémon. When this Pokémon is knocked out [CTRL NOTE][in battle], it can change form to [CTRL FID 447][Kyurem] without moving to the P.C. If it does, and there are any of your [CTRL FID 232][Zekrom] that have been excluded from the duel, move one of the [CTRL FID 232][Zekrom] to the bench.
